import pytest
import cart

# ---------- helpers ----------

def round2(x):
    return round(float(x), 2)

# ---------- apply_discount ----------

def test_apply_discount_basic():
    assert cart.apply_discount(200, 15) == 170.0
    # percent zero or full discount
    assert cart.apply_discount(50, 0) == 50.0
    assert cart.apply_discount(100, 100) == 0.0

@ pytest.mark.parametrize("price,percent", [(-1, 10), (10, -5), (10, 105)])
def test_apply_discount_errors(price, percent):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        cart.apply_discount(price, percent)

# ---------- bulk_discount_percent ----------

def test_bulk_discount_percent():
    assert cart.bulk_discount_percent(9) == 0
    assert cart.bulk_discount_percent(10) == 5
    assert cart.bulk_discount_percent(49) == 5
    assert cart.bulk_discount_percent(50) == 10
    assert cart.bulk_discount_percent(99) == 10
    assert cart.bulk_discount_percent(100) == 15
    assert cart.bulk_discount_percent(150) == 15

@ pytest.mark.parametrize("qty", [0, -5])
def test_bulk_discount_invalid(qty):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        cart.bulk_discount_percent(qty)

# ---------- parse_coupon ----------

def test_parse_coupon_valid():
    assert cart.parse_coupon("SAVE10") == 10
    assert cart.parse_coupon("save20 ") == 20
    assert cart.parse_coupon("  SaVe30") == 30

@ pytest.mark.parametrize("code", ["SAVE0", "SAVE51", "NOTACODE", "SA VE10", ""])
def test_parse_coupon_invalid(code):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        cart.parse_coupon(code)

# ---------- shipping_fee ----------

def test_shipping_fee_basic():
    assert cart.shipping_fee(0) == 60
    assert cart.shipping_fee(500) == 60
    assert cart.shipping_fee(1000) == 0
    assert cart.shipping_fee(1200) == 0

@ pytest.mark.parametrize("sub", [-5, -1])
def test_shipping_fee_errors(sub):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        cart.shipping_fee(sub)

@pytest.fixture
def empty_cart():
    return cart.Cart()

@ pytest.mark.parametrize("name,price,qty", [
    ("apple", 1.00, 3),
    ("banana", 0.5, 2),
])

def test_add_item_basic(empty_cart, name, price, qty):
    empty_cart.add_item(name, price, qty)
    assert empty_cart.items() == {name: (price, qty)}

@ pytest.mark.parametrize("existing_price", [1.00, 2.50])
def test_add_existing_increases(empty_cart, existing_price):
    empty_cart.add_item("item", existing_price, 1)
    empty_cart.add_item("item", existing_price, 4)
    assert empty_cart.items() == {"item": (existing_price, 5)}

@ pytest.mark.parametrize("new_price,qty", [(2.00, 1), (1.50, 3)])
def test_add_existing_different_price(empty_cart, new_price, qty):
    empty_cart.add_item("item", 1.00, 2)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        empty_cart.add_item("item", new_price, qty)

def test_add_item_errors(price, qty):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        empty_cart.add_item("bad", price, qty)

# Removing items ----------
def test_remove_item_basic(empty_cart):
    empty_cart.add_item("widget", 5.00, 3)
    empty_cart.remove_item("widget", 2)
    assert empty_cart.items() == {"widget": (5.00, 1)}

# Removing to zero ----------

    empty_cart.add_item("thing", 10.0, 2)
    empty_cart.remove_item("thing", 2)
    assert empty_cart.items() == {}

def test_remove_more_than_exists(empty_cart, qty):
    empty_cart.add_item("excess", 4.0, 1)
    # Removing more than present should still clear the item
    empty_cart.remove_item("excess", qty)
    assert empty_cart.items() == {}

@ pytest.mark.parametrize("name", ["nonexistent", "ghost"])
def test_remove_nonexistent(empty_cart, name):
    with pytest.raises(KeyError):
        empty_cart.remove_item(name, 1)

# Subtotal and total calculations ----------
def test_subtotal_basic(empty_cart):
    empty_cart.add_item("A", 2.0, 3)  # 6.0
    empty_cart.add_item("B", 5.5, 1)  # 5.5
    assert empty_cart.subtotal() == 11.5

# Total with no coupon, non-member ----------
def test_total_no_coupon_nonmember(empty_cart):
    empty_cart.add_item("A", 10.0, 2)  # subtotal 20
    expected = 20 + cart.shipping_fee(20)
    assert empty_cart.total() == round2(expected)

    empty_cart.add_item("A", 40.0, 1)  # subtotal 40

    discounted = expected_sub * (1 - cart.parse_coupon("SAVE10") / 100)
    shipping = cart.shipping_fee(discounted)
    expected_total = round2(discounted + shipping)
    assert empty_cart.total(coupon="SAVE10") == expected_total

def test_total_member_with_coupon(empty_cart):
    empty_cart.add_item("A", 1000.0, 1)  # subtotal 1000 (free shipping)
    total = empty_cart.total(member=True, coupon="SAVE20")
    # Subtotal stays 1000; discount 20% => 800
    expected = round2(800 + cart.shipping_fee(800))
    assert total == expected

# Empty cart total ----------
def test_total_empty(empty_cart):
    assert empty_cart.total() == 0.0

# Invalid coupon passed to total should raise ValueError
@ pytest.mark.parametrize("coupon", ["BADCODE", "SAVE101"])
def test_total_invalid_coupon(empty_cart, coupon):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        empty_cart.total(coupon=coupon)
